data.title: Quits rate, information sector (BLS JOLTS)
data.summary: The seasonally adjusted quits rate in the US information sector was 1.1% in June 2026 (preliminary), down from 1.9% in June 2022: fewer seats are being vacated by the people already in them.
data.citation: US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey, series JTS510000000000000QUR (Quits rate, information, seasonally adjusted).
